_comment: Regression spec for stelftools.ident.run_one + ident.output. Each entry pairs a Bootlin toolchain with the matching cross-gcc, a target binary compiled from samples/src/main.c with that gcc, and the (yara, alist, dlist) signature triple generated from the same toolchain's static libraries. The builder lives in tests/build_ident_goldens.py; the heavy intermediate state (full toolchain extract, signature triple, target binary) lives in .cache/_bootlin_work/ and is gitignored. Only the small text goldens under tests/golden_ident/ are committed. Schema v2 supersedes v1 (yara-only against Bootlin libc.a leaves); v1 exercised the basic ident pipeline but matched cross-toolchain noise. v2 builds the target with the same toolchain that supplied the signatures, so YARA match + alias delete + depend-ID is exercised against a realistic match rate. The link-order identification path is *not* yet covered -- DubMaker's gcc-driven dummy build converges only on the very first clean-cache invocation and reliably hits its loop_limit on every subsequent run; coverage there is blocked on making that path reproducible across Python invocations.
